requirement.original: Why do jade and dev daemon work fine despite find_peak_snapshot only checking the first home?
requirement.clarified: Snapshots are written globally (identically to all homes), so checking only the first home returns the correct peak. The break is a latent bug masked by the global-write behavior.
requirement.what: Remove the break statement on line 372 of find_peak_snapshot() that stops iteration after the first home
requirement.why: The break is a latent bug -- it works today only because write_json_snapshot writes identical snapshots to all homes. If that assumption ever breaks, find_peak_snapshot silently fails for non-default homes.

included: Add clarifying comment about global snapshot writes

success_criteria: No functional regression in peak protection behavior

root_cause_analysis.symptom: find_peak_snapshot() has a break after checking only the first home directory
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: The break was added as a performance optimization ('only check first home' comment). It is currently harmless because write_json_snapshot() writes identical global snapshots to ALL homes. But it is a latent bug: if snapshot writing ever becomes per-home, peak protection silently fails for jade/dev/qijie.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: N/A - investigating existing behavior, not a regression
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Performance optimization -- checking one home is sufficient when all homes have identical snapshots
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: Hidden coupling between write_json_snapshot (global writes) and find_peak_snapshot (reads only first). If write behavior changes, read silently breaks.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Present since peak protection was implemented

context.codebase_state: The break is on line 372 of /root/bin/happy-session-recovery.sh

development_approach.strategy: Delete the break statement on line 372. Optionally add a comment noting snapshots are global.
development_approach.validation_approach: Verify find_peak_snapshot iterates all homes by reading the modified function. Verify session watcher continues working.

research_findings.reason: Straightforward investigation of existing shell script logic with clear root cause
